title: Seema Tapakai
desc: Sri, the son of a wealthy businessman, falls for Satya, a girl who despises rich people. To impress her, Sri pretends to be poor and ropes in his family to do the same for him.

title: Love Guru
desc: Arivu, a workaholic businessman, falls head over heels for Leela, a dreamer bound by family duties. Their arranged marriage faces challenges as her aspirations clash with reality.

title: Veera Simha Reddy
desc: Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.

title: Baak
desc: Shiva's search for the truth behind his estranged sister's death leads him to her mansion, where a mysterious supernatural presence lurks. Can he stop it before it consumes him?

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Daaku Maharaaj
desc: A brave thief fights to survive and claim his territory. However, he battles powerful enemies, aiming to become a leader without a real kingdom.

title: Manyam Puli
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Current
desc: Sushanth, a college student, believes in living in the present while Sneha, his girlfriend, believes in planning for the future. Due to their contrasting personalities, they part ways with each other.

title: Kaththi
desc: A fugitive encounters his doppelgänger and plots to steal his identity for a quick escape. However, fate intervenes as he chooses to embrace and fight for his look-alike's mission.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Skanda: The Attacker
desc: After Rayudu and Ranjith Reddy's children elope, the CMs turn against each other. However, when a college student kidnaps Reddy's daughter, a revenge saga unravels.

title: Janatha Garage
desc: When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.

title: Chandramukhi
desc: When a royal family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their mansion, they get in touch with a renowned psychiatrist to trace and tackle the possessed individual.

title: SALAAR PART 1
desc: The future of a fiercely disputed nation hinges on the strained dynamics between Deva and Vardha Raja, two allies-turned-enemies.
